reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch treat the angels who called down judgment and the LORD who sent it as one divine agency, not two rival destroyers.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells presses Genesis 19 as naming two distinct destroyers, the angels claiming credit in verse 13 and the LORD acting directly in verse 24, without the text ever picking one.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).
